title: Taiheiyo Cement forecasts drop in profit for 2027 financial year
summary: Taiheiyo Cement forecasts drop in profit for 2027 financial year
body_markdown:
**Japan:** Taiheiyo Cement has announced its financial results for the first half of the 2027 financial year (FY 2027), up to 30 September 2026. The company reported a drop in profit of 13% year-on-year, to US$182m. Its full-year FY 2027 forecast for consolidated profit has decreased by 21%, from the previous forecast of US$443m, to US$351m.


In the second quarter of FY 2027, from July to September 2026, consolidated ordinary profit decreased to US$104m, a 29% drop year-on-year.
